hooks.command: input=$(cat); printf "%s" "$input" | jq -e '.tool_input.command // "" | test("git commit")' >/dev/null || exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if cargo fmt --check >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; echo "Blocked: cargo fmt --check failed. Run cargo fmt, restage, and retry the commit." >&2; exit 2
